describe.description: The creature is shown in side profile facing right against a plain light background. It has a low, elongated quadrupedal body with a broad flat head, four short fleshy limbs, and a long broad tapering tail. The ventral skin and limbs are pale pinkish-gray with wrinkled texture and darker mottling on the head, while the entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the tip of the tail is covered in overlapping large brown keratinous scales. Six feathery external gills extend from the sides of the neck behind the head.
